Research

Instrumentation development

Detector and readout technology development for next-generation rare-event searches.

Overview

Rare-event searches live or die by their instrumentation: the reach of a dark matter or neutrino experiment is set by how cleanly and efficiently it can register tiny depositions of energy against a background of noise and radioactivity.

The group develops detector and readout technology for next-generation experiments, with a particular focus on silicon-photomultiplier-based Photo Detection Modules (PDMs) and the systems that surround them.

Current activities

Current activities include the development and characterisation of Photo Detection Modules of the type built for the DarkSide-20k neutron veto, and demonstrator systems that double as public-engagement tools.
